player_prompt.intro:
O kaŋko ko Player {player_id} e ɗemngal Rock-Paper-Scissors ɗen {num_rounds}-round.
Go'o kuɓol o woni nyoƴƴa ɗemngal ɗi ɗo ɗo.
E ɗemngal ɗi, ina jawdi e ɓuri: '[rock]', '[paper]', ko '[scissors]'.
E ɗon haari, o yaaɓi '[r]', '[p]', ko '[s]' e ɓangal.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ayyi aɗa wata hara. Cee [rock], [paper], ko [scissors].

outcome.p1_wins: Ɓurɗo mo'ugo 1 heɓi ko ɓuri fuu!
outcome.draw: Jaɓɓorgo Kewuuji ngenndi Ɗi ɗon fota!
